listing.name: Skate 2 (Skate2Recompiled)
listing.summary: A Skate 2 Windows 10/11 x86-64 AVX2 setup/player route, separate from Skate 3 and other implementations. Drag your own USA English/French Xbox 360 ISO onto Setup.bat to extract and recompile locally. It targets title 4541087F, default.xex SHA-1 a9b539c1acbc80aeaade3ffbe708e1fbd3a2dad7. Other regions and title updates need different address configuration. No other completed platform package is established. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
